newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar subdued, spreads dominate.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar subdued, spreads dominate.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was mixed in subdued morning trade, with activity centred on spreads.
"There's still some interest in August/October, as well as October/March," one trader said.

October was most active with 512 lots of a total 1,012 done by 1010 GMT. It last traded 80 cents higher at $315.00. August rose by $1.40 to $320.60, widening the spread again. March last traded unchanged at $314.90.
In fundamental news, European Union beet sugar output is expected to fall to 16.05 million tonnes in 1997/98 (July/June) from 16.51 million last season, the European Commission said on Wednesday.

It also saw 1.0 million tonnes of non-quota "C" sugar being carried over into 1998/99, against 917,000 tonnes carried over into 1997/98. It put "C" sugar exports at 1.95 million tonnes in 1997/98, down from 2.44 million in 1996/97.
